_lab.title: New page, existing world
_lab.description: The surface-scope round: a whole new page inside an established world. concept-seed --scope surface deals three of the agent's grounded structures as equal cards; the world is fixed, only composition rolls. This fixture shows the code-led channel, wireframe schematics drawn by the page; comp-led rounds carry generated comps in the same slots.
_lab.when: The site already has its world (a new page on an existing product): the roll deals three structures, the user locks one in.

title: Choose the structure
question: The roll dealt three structures for Relay's new integrations page. The world stays Relay's own.

options.label: The Ledger Spine
options.thesis: One continuous integration ledger: a single dense spine of rows, no card grid.
options.viewport: An alphabetical spine with a sticky category rail; the first row is already an integration, not a hero.
options.risk: Reads austere if the row rhythm is not varied.

options.label: The Switchboard
options.thesis: Integrations as a patch board: every connection a socket, wired or empty.
options.viewport: A dense board of sockets under one search field; wired sockets glow, empty ones invite.
options.risk: Density overwhelms if socket states are not instantly legible.

options.label: The Pipeline Map
options.thesis: Integrations shown where they act: stations along the release pipeline.
options.viewport: A horizontal pipeline with integration stations; below it, the station detail for the selected stop.
options.risk: The map reads decorative if stations do not carry real state.
